'''Joe Canalin''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[January 2001 San Jose tournament]] on 13 January 2001 with [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Ops / Build D*II]], according to Nick Stefanko's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1626">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-15-san-jose-ca-1-13-01d1626/ san-jose-ca-1-13-01], DeckTech (Nick "JediBrain" Stefanko, 15 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-15-san-jose-ca-1-13-01d1626/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
